metadata.description: Claude skills and tools I use every week, cleaned up so you can install them or build your own.

plugins.name: gdocs-suggest
plugins.description: Claude comments on, copyedits and fills gaps in a Google Doc, with every word it adds in red or marked [Claude].

plugins.name: zotero-librarian
plugins.description: Turns a DOI, arXiv ID, URL or half-remembered title into a clean, correctly typed record in your Zotero library.

plugins.name: skill-release
plugins.description: Checks a skill before you share it, then exports a cleaned copy one way into a public repo. Your private patterns stay outside it.
